newsitem.title: USA: PH Glatfelter sees Q3 hurt by maintenance outages.
newsitem.headline: PH Glatfelter sees Q3 hurt by maintenance outages.

text.p: P.H. Glatfelter Co said Wednesday its third quarter results will be hurt by "normal annual maintenance shutdowns" at its facilities.
The company said its cigarette paper producing machines will remain down for an additional four to five days because domestic cigarette makers have cut their inventories.

Although the outages will affect third quarter results, Glatfelter said it is optimistic about earnings prospects for the second half of the year, if price increases for its printing paper products are implemented.
For the third quarter of 1997, analysts forecast the company's net income to be $0.41 per share, as tracked by First Call.
